key_insight: The paper shows that quantum software engineering can combine FPGAs and AI to build a practical hybrid framework for quantum device certification via entanglement testing.
engineering_relevance: It demonstrates a systematic, reproducible approach to quantum certification that could improve how NISQ-era hardware is validated and monitored.
method: Built QAccCert as a hybrid certification framework using QSE principles
Implemented CHSH-based entanglement certification in Qiskit AerSimulator
Used LLM-guided optimization to search parameter space more efficiently than random search
evidence_signal: In simulation, the approach reached 99.94% of the theoretical CHSH maximum of 2√2, indicating strong entanglement certification performance.
watch_item: The results are based on ideal simulator experiments, so real hardware noise, decoherence, and FPGA/AI integration overhead still need validation.
paper_title: Quantum Software Engineering in Practice: FPGA and AI Integration for Quantum Certification
